protocol_name: MSTT_RUL SOH development, HNEI exploration, and pre-BIT confirmation freeze
claim_limit: BIT is public historical data. The protocol may be described as prospectively specified and frozen before any BIT model evaluation, not as a prospectively collected cohort.

soh_definition.valid_observation: finite numeric discharge capacity in Ah within [0.5, 1.5] times the dataset-declared nominal capacity
soh_definition.trajectory_observation_gate: Outside the BOL-reference calculation, a capacity observation must be finite, positive, and no greater than 1.5 times declared nominal; genuine late-life values below 0.5 nominal are retained.
soh_definition.bol_reference_quality_gate: The median of the first five valid observations must lie within [0.8, 1.2] times the dataset-declared nominal capacity; this rejects already-normalized values mislabeled as Ah.
soh_definition.chronology: Use the chronologically first five valid observations. Never substitute later observations because the first five appear unusual after viewing the full life.

ah_to_soh_conversion.rule: All additive absolute-Ah hyperparameters are divided by the prespecified 2.0-Ah XJTU development reference; no HNEI or BIT performance is used.

development_data.normalization: Ignore any supplied smoothed-capacity column; recompute a seven-cycle causal trailing mean from raw Ah, then divide raw and recomputed model capacity by the median of the first five valid raw capacities for that physical cell.

task.title: fixed-cutoff recursive SOH forecasting under unknown future operating conditions
task.rmse_support: Genuinely observed SOH points after cutoff through the first observed EOL upper bound or the right-censoring boundary, whichever applies, and no later than cutoff plus the frozen horizon.
task.cell_weighting: One RMSE per physical cell; physical cells receive equal inferential weight.
task.seed_aggregation: Average the three predicted SOH trajectories pointwise, then calculate one cell-level metric.
task.missing_cycle_input: Causal last observation carried forward on the physical-cycle grid; no backward fill or future interpolation.
unknown_future_forbidden_inputs: statistics computed from the complete future trajectory
task.known_future_current_oracle: Exploratory only and never mixed with the primary unknown-future-condition table.

features.scaler: StandardScaler fitted only on the relevant XJTU training cells for each selection, refit, or outer cross-fitting fold.

training.common_support_gate: Both neural arms use identical cell and target-cycle support.

conformal.method: four-fold batch-stratified outer cross-fitting at the physical-cell level
conformal.fold_construction: Sort B1 and B3 cell IDs independently; assign two B1 and two B3 cells to each outer fold.
conformal.within_fold_epoch_selection: Remaining B1 cells train and remaining B3 cells select epoch; the outer-held-out cells are not used.
conformal.seed_aggregation: Pointwise mean predicted SOH trajectory across seeds before scoring.
conformal.nonconformity_score: Maximum absolute SOH error over evaluable genuinely observed post-cutoff points for a cell, yielding a simultaneous trajectory band.
conformal.finite_sample_quantile: ceil((n+1)*(1-alpha))-th ordered score, clipped to n

hnei.role: exploratory cross-institutional replication and pipeline stress test
hnei.if_performance_changes_model: increment to v0.2.1 and treat HNEI as development-exposed
hnei.post_result_decision_receipt: An explicit unchanged decision is required before BIT structure preflight; a modified decision blocks v0.2.0.

bit.dataset_title: Battery Degradation Dataset (Fixed Current Profiles and Arbitrary Uses Profiles)
bit.actual_counts_rule: Actual counts are determined only by the frozen archive inventory and landmark flow.
pre_freeze_allowed: availability of the physical cycle-190 landmark
pre_freeze_forbidden: cell selection based on model output
cutoff selection based on model output
bit.gatekeeping: Test H2 confirmatorily only if two-sided H1 p < 0.05. No Holm adjustment is applied to H1 and gated H2.
bit.cohort_pooling: No ordinary pooled paired p value. Optional overall summaries use cohort-stratified bootstrap and report heterogeneity.
flow_counts: RMSE analysis set with at least five future SOH observations
timing analysis set with observed or interval-determined EOL

statistics.permutation_method: paired sign-flip randomization on cell-level differences
statistics.zero_difference_rule: Retain zeros in descriptive and bootstrap estimates; zero signs do not affect the sign-flip statistic.
statistics.missing_pair_rule: Use complete model pairs only and report the missing-pair cell IDs and reasons.
statistics.stopping_rule: Use every eligible frozen physical cell; do not stop early based on significance.
statistics.effect_direction: Positive comparator-minus-full RMSE favors full K5.

hnei_exploratory_family.inference_label: descriptive exploratory; no confirmatory multiplicity claim

required_before_first_BIT_model_output: GitHub release for the exact frozen commit
model, scaler, parser, config, archive, and manifest SHA-256 values
registration.allowed_wording: prospectively specified and frozen before any BIT model evaluation
